name: B10-0088/2026 (Verts/ALE) – Case of Joseph Figueira Martin in the Central African Republic
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Joseph Figueira Martin in the Central African Republic
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling for the release of Joseph Figueira Martin, a humanitarian researcher held in the Central African Republic. He was kidnapped in 2024, held for over 17 months, and sentenced to 10 years of forced labour. The Parliament says the charges are unfounded and that his work is being criminalised. It also asks the European Union to put pressure on the country's authorities and to consider suspending financial support to its government, except for humanitarian aid.

- The Parliament demands his immediate release and proper medical care and legal access.
- It asks the European Union to press the Central African Republic and weigh suspending support.
- It urges the European Union to better protect aid workers worldwide and support their families.
